items.title: A rational map into a proper scheme can be made a morphism by a modification
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for schemes X, Y over S with X Noetherian and Y proper over S, an S-rational map f : U -> Y extends to a morphism f' : X' -> Y after a proper morphism p : X' -> X that is an isomorphism over U (source lines 9451-9462). The proof takes the scheme theoretic image X' of (f, j) : U -> Y x_S X, uses properness of the projection Y x_S X -> X (base change of Y -> S) and stability under closed immersion and composition to make p proper, and uses Morphisms' criterion for the scheme theoretic image of a partial section, together with retrocompactness of U in the Noetherian X, to get p^{-1}(U) = U; the morphism to Y is the second projection restricted to X'.
